prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1008; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the severity of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align with a cervical strain pattern. Over the course of care, the patient attended 25 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury, and progress was gradual. Range of motion testing and palpation revealed findings that support the clinical diagnosis, including reduced cervical rotation and localized paraspinal tenderness, while several neurological screening tests and imaging-related assessments returned within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known from the patient history. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for services rendered. Ongoing home exercise instruction was provided, and the patient was advised to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological signs develop.
